compliance_deadlines: Annual review and revision of the Basic Plan for the time being
implementation_notes: Adopted by Cabinet Decision on December 23, 2025 pursuant to Article 18(1) of the Act on the Promotion of Research, Development, and Utilization of AI-Related Technologies (Act No. 53 of 2025). Implementation and follow-up are led by the AI Strategy Headquarters (chaired by the Prime Minister and comprising all Cabinet ministers) and the AI Strategy Promotion Council, supported by expert consultations through the AI Strategy Expert Panel and benchmark-based monitoring. The plan relies on agile PDCA cycles, voluntary industry initiatives backed by guidelines under Article 13 of the AI Act, risk surveys under Article 16, immediate doubling of AI Safety Institute (AISI) personnel, and alignment with the Science, Technology, and Innovation Basic Plan and the Priority Plan for the Realization of a Digital Society.
